findings.message: The Discovery Files section states 'We find llms.txt present on dotfusion.com' as a site-wide fact, but Priority 6 in the Findings section lists llms.txt as one of 'all five discovery artefacts absent', contradicting each other; one of these is an overreach of the audited evidence.
findings.context: We find llms.txt present on dotfusion.com with a site description in place, which gives machines a starting point

findings.message: The Soft 404 resilience check in Agent Reading Pipeline is marked 'Pass 7/7' with the note 'Missing pages return a proper HTTP 404 status', but the Error Page Test section explicitly records that the site returns HTTP 200 (soft 404) for a non-existent page, directly contradicting this pass verdict.
